title: 第1章 狗仔变饿狼第2章 创造机会

第一章 狗仔变饿狼
洛杉矶综合医院。
白光从一丝丝的隙缝中射进了眼睛，林如意慢慢看清了周围的事物，发现这里不是自己的家，而是医院的病房。
他慢慢坐起来，回忆着之前的事，确信自己什么也没干，只是像往常一样按时睡觉，那为什么会在这里？难道是食物中毒？煤气中毒？
“叶先生，你醒了？”一个黑人女护士问着，随手按响了墙上的铃。
她在叫谁？我不姓叶啊。林如意觉得很奇怪，更奇怪的是他挂着点滴的手，那是一只巨大的手，往上是一条粗壮的，肌肉发达的小麦色手臂，三角肌上纹着一个青色的、狰狞的狼头。这条胳膊根本就不属于他，他以前的胳膊也很粗，但全是肥肉。
我变成了契丹人？这梦好奇怪，我还是再睡一会儿吧，林如意又躺在了床上。闭了一会儿眼，他感觉不太对劲，手好像有点疼，是输液扎针的感觉。
他又坐了起来，摸了摸自己的脸，脸也已经变样了，不再是那张胖脸，变的很有棱角；再摸摸肚皮，大肚腩也没了，取而代之的是六快明显的腹肌，再向上是结实的胸肌。
不是做梦？这是怎么回事？难道我被改造了输入了什么奇怪血清？我是中国人，没理由让我成为“美国队长”吧？
这时，一名四十岁左右的白人医生进了屋，笑问道：“叶先生，你感觉怎么样？我们还以为你会成为植物人，天啊，这真是个奇迹。你看看这是几？”
说着，他伸出了几根手指，林如意对答如流，答完问道：“医生，我在哪里？这是怎么回事？今天是几号？”
“你在洛杉矶综合医院，你在球场上被闪电击中了，已经昏迷十天。现在是……”医生看了一眼墙上的挂历，轻道：“2007年7月4日。”
2007年？我回到了2007年？林如意深吸了一口气，只有一个可能性，他穿了……怎么在家睡觉也能穿越？！睡觉前，他还在2012年5月。他急忙问道：“你们这里有没有镜子？”
护士从桌上拿起一面镜子递了过来，林如意接过来一照，顿时惊呆了。镜中的人剑眉星目，脸部轮廓棱角分明，是一张标准东方帅哥的脸，还留着类似意大利球星罗伯特.巴乔的胡子，简直无可挑剔。
这也太幸运了吧？林如意又惊又喜！他不喜欢以前的自己，他小时候就来了美国，生活和名字截然相反，一点都不如意。家庭方面父母早逝，没留下多少遗产；爱情方面更糟，他喜欢美女，但不可能吸引美女，他身材像功夫巨星洪金宝、脸型像洪金宝，五官像洪金宝，发型也像洪金宝……如果洪金宝见到他，一定会吓一跳——尼玛谁给我生了个私生子长这么大了？事业方面最失败，美国就业压力很大。他在三流大学毕业后，在洛杉矶时报找了一份临时记者的工作，学名“狗仔队”。
现在他的人生有了巨大转机。想到这里，林如意激动道：“医生，你能不能告诉我，我是谁？我是做什么的？我的大脑一片空白。”
“你不记得自己的名字？”医生皱起了眉头，昏迷了十天，失忆是有可能的。他叹了口气，轻道：“你叫叶锋，是UCLA的王牌球员。”
“王牌？我是篮球运动员？”他更高兴了，UCLA是篮球名校，出过贾巴尔，雷吉.米勒这样的巨星，乐福、维斯布鲁克也是从那里出来的。
医生确定他是失忆了。“不，你是打橄榄球的！”
不是吧？林如意连橄榄球基本规则都不懂。他叹道：“医生，你能详细说一下我的情况吗？”

医生摇了摇头道：“抱歉，我只知道你的年龄是十九岁，名字叫叶锋。你的队友肯定知道，我已经让人打电话联系了，一会儿就会有人来。”
半个小时后，一个穿着运动装，身材魁梧貌似史泰龙的壮汉走进了病房。在家庭方面，叶锋和林如忆在家庭方面惊人的相似，都是从小来到美国，父母早逝。这个名叫托巴.哈利的壮汉是他的舍友，也是第一联络人。
托巴听说叶锋失忆后，耐心的讲起了他所知道的事。
2007年6月24日，洛杉矶的上万球迷们见证了一场悲剧。UCLA（加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校）VS佛罗里达的比赛中，一道闪电劈中了球场上的球员。这个遭雷劈的超级倒霉蛋就是UCLA有“饿狼”之称的华人中线卫叶锋。
中线卫是橄榄球中很重要的一个位置，他们一般被称为防守组的指挥官，防守阵型的变换，对于对方进攻方向的常好的擒抱技巧，他们是跑锋的杀手。叶锋身高201CM，体重108公斤，摆脱能力一流，速度奇快，防守时凶残无比。大学第一赛季，他就送出了124次拦截，5次擒杀。在他昏迷的时候，入选了Pacific－10盟（赛区）最佳阵容。
叶锋受到了NFL（美式橄榄球联盟）很多球队关注，美国人希望他能成为NFL的姚明，使橄榄球运动可以在中国得到推广。在他遭雷击之前，拒绝了一些球队的邀请，准备代表UCLA再打一年，参加明年的NFL选秀。
现在叶锋虽然醒了，却被一个狗仔队成员灵魂附体。林如意对橄榄球一点兴趣都没有，在他看来，这是一种野蛮的运动，在身体对抗最激烈的球类运动中能排第二位，排第一是中国足球，那是在“死亡飞车”被发明前，最适合犯人们玩的游戏。
刚一重生，林如意就要面临重大人生选择。
参加NFL的选秀肯定是不行了，他并没有接收叶锋的记忆，根本就不会打橄榄球。他也不想放弃运动，浪费了好体质。以前他也是个体力充沛，灵活的胖子，他很喜欢运动，愿意成为一个运动员。
千万不要小看狗仔队。这些人把明星当场猎物，窥探、偷拍他们的各种照片，是他们在美国报纸媒体正在没落、正经记者成为最差职业的时候，能让娱乐杂志创造利润。
狗仔队成员们往往年轻、爷们、争强好胜。他们长期漂泊在外，紧随热点，飙车追新闻、非法入侵、打点小道消息还有私下联盟，这些都是他们的工作，有时简直就是侦探。
这职业也很危险。在中国“狗仔”最惨不过被打，而允许有枪的美国，“狗仔”可说是将脑袋挂在裤腰带上讨生活。曾有“狗仔”为让梅尔吉布森拄着拐杖的形象见报，遭遇前摩萨德特工。有人为拍摄《花花公子》宠儿帕梅拉衣不蔽体的性感模样，几乎葬身海底。而第一个得到麦当娜和她新生女儿照片的“狗仔”，险些遭到起诉……
林如意在新闻界表现出色。他跟踪过不穿内裤的布兰妮，采访过喝多了的尼古拉斯.凯奇，而最得意的成就是，他拍到过穿正常衣服的ladygaga，一度被奉为娱乐圈的神迹。后来人们才知道ladygaga经常穿正常衣服出门，只是这样别人就认不出她了。
问题是接下来他该用这新身体做什么呢？
林如意脑海中只想到了一个词汇，那就是“篮球”！他喜欢篮球，从小看NBA，是湖人队的球迷，从奥尼尔加盟湖人开始一直看到2012年。他虽然不擅长打篮球，只会跳投和三步上篮，但对这项运动非常了解。他清楚篮球规则，了解各个位置球员的特点，还懂得篮球战术。从2007年到2012年NBA有什么重大转会，哪些球员会爆发他都记得大概。他觉得如果自己经营球队，肯定能凑出一支很强的队伍来。
就改打篮球吧，我现在改练篮球肯定还来得及！林如意很快下定了决心。中国有大量球迷，只要能进入NBA，哪怕只是个角色球员，就比打橄榄球风光得多，何乐而不为呢？
对于接触篮球晚他并不担心。“大虫”罗德曼高中毕业时还没他两个妹妹高，大学才开始接触篮球照样成为了篮板王。穆托姆博20岁之前还在非洲打猎呢，一样成为了全明星，最佳防守球员。还有纳什，他以前是踢足球的，19岁才改打篮球，后来都成为了MVP。
篮球的基本功是运球，投篮和防守，跑动什么的和其他运动是相通的。所以只要喜欢打球，接触晚点也没关系，只要努力训练，再动动脑子，就有可能能成为高手。但不能什么都练，要根据自己的情况来决定主练防守还是进攻。像穆托姆博和罗德曼就是身体条件出色，靠防守起家的。而纳什身体条件差，主要练的就是突破传球和精准的投篮。
叶锋打橄榄球能入选最佳阵容，可见身体素质非常好，有可能成为好的防守球员。他越想越兴奋，准备以新身份好好活一回。
兴奋了没几分钟，一聊起了经济问题，他就高兴不起来了。

虽然在UCLA橄榄球队是个明星，但叶锋的经济状况非常糟糕，靠橄榄球队的奖学金度日。他的医疗保险是每个月直接从奖学金里面扣的。在美国做个小手术随便住上几天院，帐单就是几万美元，住院这十天，叶锋的奖学金已经快被扣光了。如果继续住下去，他就得自己支付高额的费用。
他赶紧申请了出院，经过检查，洛杉矶综合医院发现叶锋的身体已经完全康复，他顺利办理了出院手续。

Chapter 1 The paparazzi turns into a hungry wolf
Los Angeles General Hospital.
White light shot into her eyes through the slightest crack. Lin Ruyi slowly saw the things around her clearly, and realized that this was not her home, but a hospital ward.
He slowly sat up and recalled what happened before, making sure that he had done nothing but go to bed on time as usual, so why was he here? Could it be food poisoning? Gas poisoning?
"Mr. Ye, are you awake?" a black female nurse asked, and rang the bell on the wall.
Who is she calling? My surname is not Ye. Lin Ruyi found it strange, and what was even stranger was the hand with the drip hanging on it. It was a huge hand, with a thick, muscular wheat-colored arm on top, and a green, ferocious wolf head tattooed on the deltoid muscle. This arm doesn't belong to him at all. His previous arms were also thick, but they were all fat.
Have I become a Khitan? This dream is so strange. I'd better sleep a little longer. Lin Ruyi was lying on the bed again. After closing his eyes for a while, he felt something was wrong. His hand seemed to hurt a little, which was the feeling of an infusion and a needle.
He sat up again, touched his face, and found that his face had changed. It was no longer the fat face, but had become more angular. He touched his belly again, and found that the big belly was gone, replaced by six fast and obvious abdominal muscles, and then strong chest muscles.
Not a dream? What's going on? Could it be that I was modified and injected with some strange serum? I am Chinese, there is no reason for me to become "Captain America", right?
At this time, a white doctor about forty years old came into the room and asked with a smile: "Mr. Ye, how do you feel? We thought you would become a vegetative state. Oh my God, this is really a miracle. Look at this?"
As he spoke, he stretched out a few fingers, and Lin Ruyi answered fluently. After answering, she asked: "Doctor, where am I? What's going on? What's the date today?"
"You are in Los Angeles General Hospital. You were struck by lightning on the court and have been in a coma for ten days. Now..." The doctor glanced at the calendar on the wall and said lightly: "July 4, 2007."
2007? Am I back in 2007? Lin Ruyi took a deep breath. There was only one possibility. He wore it... How could he travel through time while sleeping at home? ! Before going to bed, he was still in May 2012. He hurriedly asked: "Do you have a mirror here?"
The nurse picked up a mirror from the table and handed it over. Lin Ruyi took it and took a look, and was stunned. The man in the mirror has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and his face is sharp and angular. He has the face of a standard oriental handsome boy. He also has a beard similar to that of Italian star Roberto Baggio. He is simply impeccable.
This is too lucky, right? Lin Ruyi was surprised and happy! He didn't like his old self. He came to the United States when he was a child. His life was completely opposite to his name, and he was not satisfied at all. In terms of family, his parents died young and did not leave much inheritance; in terms of love, it is even worse. He likes beautiful women, but it is impossible to attract beautiful women. His body is like kung fu superstar Sammo Hung, his face is like Sammo Hung, his facial features are like Sammo Hung, and his hairstyle is like Sammo Hung... If Sammo Hung saw him, he would definitely be shocked - Damn, who gave me an illegitimate child that grew so big? The biggest failure in career is that the employment pressure in the United States is very high. After graduating from a third-rate university, he found a job as a temporary reporter at the Los Angeles Times, known as "Paparazzi."
Now his life has taken a huge turn for the better. Thinking of this, Lin Ruyi said excitedly: "Doctor, can you tell me, who am I? What do I do? My mind is blank."
"You don't remember your name?" The doctor frowned. He was in a coma for ten days. Amnesia was possible. He sighed and said softly: "Your name is Ye Feng, you are UCLA's ace player."
"Ace? Am I a basketball player?" He was even more happy. UCLA is a famous basketball school and has produced superstars like Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Reggie Miller, and Love., Westbrook also came from there.
The doctor determined that he had lost his memory. "No, you play rugby!"
Isn't it? Lin Ruyi doesn’t even understand the basic rules of rugby. He sighed: "Doctor, can you tell me more about my situation?"
The doctor shook his head and said, "I'm sorry, I only know that you are nineteen years old and your name is Ye Feng. Your teammates must know. I have already called someone to contact you, and someone will be here soon."
Half an hour later, a burly man in sportswear who looked like Stallone walked into the ward. In terms of family, Ye Feng and Lin Ruyi are surprisingly similar. They both came to the United States when they were young, and their parents died young. This strong man named Toba Harry is his roommate and first point of contact.
After Toba heard that Ye Feng had lost his memory, he patiently told what he knew.
On June 24, 2007, tens of thousands of fans in Los Angeles witnessed a tragedy. During the UCLA (University of California, Los Angeles) vs. Florida game, a bolt of lightning struck the players on the court. The unlucky guy who was struck by lightning was Ye Feng, a Chinese middle linebacker from UCLA known as the "Hungry Wolf."
Middle linebackers are a very important position in football. They are generally called the commanders of the defensive team. They can change the defensive formation and have very good tackling skills for the opponent's offensive direction. They are killers of running backs. Ye Feng is 201cm tall and weighs 108kg. He has first-class escape ability, extremely fast speed, and is extremely ferocious in defense. In his first season in college, he made 124 interceptions and 5 sacks. When he was in a coma, he was selected to the Pacific-10 League (division) best team.
Ye Feng has attracted the attention of many teams in the NFL (American Football League). Americans hope that he can become the Yao Ming of the NFL so that rugby can be promoted in China. Before he was struck by lightning, he rejected invitations from some teams and was preparing to represent UCLA for another year and participate in next year's NFL draft.
Although Ye Feng is awake now, he is possessed by the soul of a paparazzi member. Lin Ruyi has no interest in rugby at all. In his opinion, it is a barbaric sport. It ranks second among the most physically intense ball games. The first is Chinese football, which was the most suitable game for prisoners before the invention of "death racing".
As soon as she was reborn, Lin Ruyi had to face a major life choice.
It's definitely not possible to participate in the NFL draft. He has no memory of accepting Ye Feng and he doesn't know how to play football at all. He also didn't want to give up exercise and waste his good physique. He used to be a fat man with plenty of physical strength and flexibility. He loved sports and was willing to become an athlete.
Never underestimate the paparazzi. These people prey on celebrities, spy on them, and secretly take various photos of them. They allow entertainment magazines to create profits at a time when American newspaper media is declining and serious journalists have become the worst profession.
Paparazzi members tend to be young, manly, and competitive. They have been wandering away for a long time, following hot spots, racing to catch up with news, illegal intrusions, collecting gossip and private alliances. These are their jobs, and sometimes they are simply detectives.
This profession is also dangerous. In China, the worst thing for "paparazzi" is to be beaten. In the United States, where guns are allowed, "paparazzi" can be said to hang their heads on their belts to earn a living. A "paparazzi" once encountered a former Mossad agent after an image of Mel Gibson on crutches was published in the newspaper. Someone almost died at the bottom of the sea trying to take a picture of Pamela, the darling of Playboy, looking half-dressed and sexy. And the first "paparazzi" to get photos of Madonna and her newborn daughter was almost prosecuted...
Lin Ruyi has performed well in the press. He has followed Britney when she was not wearing underwear, interviewed Nicolas Cage when he was drunk, and his most proud achievement is that he photographed wearing a formal dress.Lady Gaga, who wears regular clothes, was once regarded as a miracle in the entertainment industry. Later, people learned that Lady Gaga often wears normal clothes when going out, just so that others cannot recognize her.
The question is what should he do with this new body next?
Lin Ruyi only thought of one word in her mind, and that was "basketball"! He likes basketball. He has watched the NBA since he was a child and is a fan of the Lakers. He has watched O'Neal since joining the Lakers in 2012. Although he is not good at playing basketball and only knows jump shots and three-step layups, he knows the sport very well. He knows the rules of basketball, the characteristics of players in each position, and basketball tactics. He roughly remembers any major NBA transfers from 2007 to 2012 and which players will break out. He felt that if he ran the team by himself, he would definitely be able to put together a strong team.
Just switch to basketball. It’s definitely not too late for me to switch to basketball now! Lin Ruyi quickly made up her mind. There are a large number of fans in China. As long as you can enter the NBA, even if you are just a role player, it will be much more glorious than playing rugby. Why not?
He is not worried about picking up basketball late. "Big Bug" Rodman was not taller than his two younger sisters when he graduated from high school. He only started playing basketball in college and still became the rebounding leader. Mutombo was still hunting in Africa before he was 20 years old, and he also became an All-Star and the best defensive player. And Nash, he used to play football, but he switched to basketball at the age of 19, and later became an MVP.
The basic skills of basketball are dribbling, shooting and defense. Running and other sports are similar to other sports. So as long as you like to play, it doesn't matter if you start playing later. As long as you train hard and use your brain, you may become a master. But you can’t practice everything. You have to decide whether to coach defense or offense based on your own situation. Mutombo and Rodman, for example, have excellent physical conditions and started their careers on defense. Nash's physical condition is poor, so he mainly practices breakthrough passing and precise shooting.
Ye Feng was selected to the best team when playing rugby, which shows that he has very good physical fitness and may become a good defensive player. The more he thought about it, the more excited he became, ready to live a good life with his new identity.
After being excited for a few minutes, he couldn't be happy anymore as soon as he started talking about financial issues.
Although he was a star on the UCLA football team, Ye Feng's financial situation was very bad and he relied on a scholarship from the football team to survive. His medical insurance is deducted directly from the scholarship every month. A minor surgery in the United States and a stay in a hospital for just a few days would cost tens of thousands of dollars. During these ten days of hospitalization, Ye Feng's scholarship had almost been deducted. If he continues to live there, he will have to pay high fees himself.
He quickly applied for discharge. After examination, Los Angeles General Hospital found that Ye Feng's body had fully recovered, and he successfully completed the discharge procedures.
